contracts_rationale: Test and scenario-hygiene mission: no API, event or schema interface is added or changed.
friendly_name: Module-local test gaps and promise-first scenario verdicts
purpose_context: The 2026-11-03 test suite assessment found that each module's own tests reach less than the aggregate coverage suggests (W1, W2, R4, #370): kernel.validation has 58 % branch coverage, profiles a 53 % mutation score with 29 untouched mutants, and packs.infra.fetch's CappedBodySubscriber no test of its own. It also found 27 promise-first scenarios that predate the Cucumber harness and run under no runner (R8, #374). This mission closes the module gaps with tests proved by planted breaks and gives each of the 27 scenarios a recorded map, wire or retire verdict.
purpose_tldr: Give kernel validation, profiles and the guide fetcher's body cap tests of their own, and decide what happens to 27 scenarios no test runner executes.
